answer_verbatim:
The **best online courses** for learning shadow work and spiritual practice are the ones that combine a clear structure, guided exercises, and a credible teacher or platform. From the results you provided, the strongest options are **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** on Jung Platform, **Embracing The Shadow** by Charlie Morley, and the **Shadow Mastery Course** from Centre of Excellence.[3][10][4]

A practical short list, based on the available descriptions:

| Course | Why it stands out | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** | Directly framed around Jungian shadow work, which is one of the most established approaches to the topic.[3] | Learners who want a psychologically grounded introduction |
| **Embracing The Shadow** | Taught by Charlie Morley and positioned as a shadow-work course with a spiritual-development angle.[10] | People who want shadow work with a mindfulness/spiritual emphasis |
| **Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises** | Explicitly includes exercises and is presented as a structured online shadow-work course.[4] | Self-paced learners who want guided practice |
| **Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course** | Certificate-based and oriented toward practitioner-level learning.[5] | Learners who want a more formal credential |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** | A popular Udemy-style option focused on healing and integration.[2] | Budget-conscious learners who want accessible, broad instruction |

If your goal is *spiritual practice plus shadow work*, the most relevant fit from these results is **Embracing The Shadow** because it is explicitly centered on spiritual growth while addressing shadow work.[10] If your goal is a more traditional, psychology-oriented foundation, **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** is the clearest match.[3]

A few other options worth noting:
- **Shadow Work Journal by ManTalks Training** may suit people who prefer a journaling-based approach.[1]
- **Shadow Work Courses Hub** offers multiple mini-courses and bundles, which may be useful if you want a modular format rather than one long program.[7]
- **Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing and Growth** on Insight Timer is another spiritually oriented option, especially if you already use meditation platforms.[11]
